title: Trying To Punch a Cop Goes Horribly Wrong
description:
On June 28th, 2022, officers responded to a motor accident. Upon arriving at the scene, the officer could observe a wrecked vehicle. As he tried to approach its driver, he began acting in a very agitated manner and yelling at the officer. Suddenly, the man took a combative stance and almost hit one of the officers. Due to the man’s illness, he continued to behave in an agitated manner. Shortly after, he was taken to the hospital. He was charged with aggravated assault on a peace officer.
